title: New Saddle Recipe Now
description: Adds the new saddle recipe before the update
body:
# Adds the new saddle recipe before the update.

Mojang have announced that saddles will be made craftable. This adds the recipe they will have into the game before the update is released.

## The recipe:
![The recipe for a saddle. Three leather in an up arrow shape, with an iron ingot in the middle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9817e5bd14242fd3a7f42fe2b8374a56b2eacba8.png)
